pythonFunction.name: update_shipping_address
pythonFunction.description:
Changes the shipping address of one order to what the caller said. Send only the parts the caller gave. Call it after the caller is verified and has given the order number and the new address.

Args:
  order_number: The order number the caller gave, for example "102" or "00000102".
  street: New street and number, exactly as the caller said it.
  city: New city, only if the caller gave one.
  state: New state or province, only if the caller gave one.
  postal_code: New postal code, only if the caller gave one.
  country: New country, only if the caller gave one.

Returns:
  dict: ok and updated_fields. If error is not_found, not_confirmed or invalid_input fix that; if system_error is true, apologize and escalate.
